name: FileGuardian Telegram Bot
description: High-speed Telegram content protection, auto-filter, and file delivery bot with dual delivery modes and MTProto indexer.

DEVELOPER_ID.description: Your numeric Telegram User ID (from @userinfobot or /id).

TELEGRAM_API_ID.description: Telegram API ID from https://my.telegram.org for high-speed MTProto indexing.

TELEGRAM_SESSION_STRING.description: Telethon StringSession for Heroku (run python generate_session_string.py locally).

DATABASE_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Optional direct URL to download pre-existing bot_database.sqlite3 on Heroku boot.

DEFAULT_AUTO_DELETE_SECONDS.description: Self-destruct timer for downloadable files in seconds (e.g. 180).

AUTH_CHANNEL_ID.description: Force-subscription channel ID or username (e.g. -1001234567890 or @MyChannel).

ADMIN_IDS.description: Optional comma-separated numeric Telegram User IDs of additional admins.

PAYWALL_ENABLED.description: Set to '1' to enable Paid Members Only mode by default, or '0' for Free Public Access.
